title: Magna increases bet on battery swapping in India with $35M for Yuma | TechCrunch
summary: Magna is now investing another $35 million in Yuma, increasing the auto supplier’s stake from the 51% it took when the joint venture was formed, Yuma managing director Muthu Subramanian said in an interview.
